name: Easy Slow Cooker Cheesy Cajun-Spiced Chicken & Broccoli with Garlic Bread

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken, soup, broth, sour cream, and Cajun seasoning in a 6-quart slow cooker insert. Stir to combine, then cover and cook until warmed through and flavors have blended, low for 4 hours or high for about 2 hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb cooked chicken (shredded)
2 (10.5 oz) can cheddar cheese soup
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth
½ cup sour cream
1 tbsp Cajun seasoning

instructions.primary_message: When the cheesy chicken is done, add broccoli to the slow cooker insert and stir to combine. Set slow cooker to high and continue to cook until broccoli is fork-tender, about 30 minutes.

Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425°F and arrange rack in the center position. Place toast on the countertop to thaw slightly. Separate toast slices, arrange on a large baking sheet pan, and place in the preheated oven. Bake until golden and toasted, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Divide chicken, broccoli, and sauce between plates or bowls. Serve with garlic toast and enjoy!
